primary_blockers: At d=2.5 cm, the initial Reference state for HOLD, RISE and FALL has multiple physically admissible quadratic roots satisfying the same Wb/Wt constraints under the frozen multistart test; the candidate is therefore not identifiable from Wb/Wt/H within this profile family.
The 64-vs-128 qH crosscheck reaches 1.9128758133035717e-08 cm/d, exceeding the preregistered 1e-08 gate.
The manufactured hydrostatic a-recovery residual reaches 1.0736922462228904e-10, slightly exceeding the preregistered 1e-10 gate.
scientific_interpretation: C4I rejects one specific C1-smooth quadratic reconstruction family. It does not prove that Wb/Wt/H are insufficient for every possible gradient closure.
The 2.5 cm ambiguity shows that two integral storage constraints do not uniquely identify this nonlinear quadratic pressure-profile family at the tested initial state.
The qualified 5 cm subset is strongly direction dependent: FALL improves, RISE worsens, and HOLD loses the near-hydrostatic zero-flux behaviour.
No post-response root-selection rule, direction switch or fitted branch selector is authorized.
